jobs.title: Implementation Manager
jobs.description:
**Vividly** is the leading modern trade promotion management (TPM) solution built by and for the consumer packaged goods industry. From campaign creation to deductions management and promotion measurement, we help brands manage every element of trade spend. With our easy-to-use platform and industry-leading experience, we pride ourselves on our ability to bring businesses to the next level.

Not familiar with trade promotion spend? That’s OK. Most people aren’t. It’s an $8 trillion dollar problem that is ripe for disruption by an innovative SaaS startup. In order to grow, consumer packaged goods (CPG) brands spend 20% of their topline revenue to get into retailers and promote their products within those retailers. The problem is that today 70% of those promotions are not ROI positive. This is because ROI is hard to track. The industry operates on emails, pdfs, and xls spreadsheets. At Vividly, we’re solving this massive problem with exciting tactics including AI, Machine Learning, and Fintech and adding value to everyone in the chain. Some of our customers include brands you may use and love - Liquid Death, Amy’s, and Perfect Snacks.

The Implementation team at Vividly plays a critical role in turning a customer's solution design into a successful, operational Vividly experience.

Our Implementation Managers are both **hands-on platform configurators and end-to-end project managers**. They take an approved solution design and translate it into Vividly configuration, customer workflows, data setup, training, testing, and ultimately go-live.

Implementation Managers serve as the primary point of contact throughout onboarding, coordinating across customers, Solution Architecture, Integrations, Managed Services, Customer Success, Product, and other internal teams to keep complex projects moving forward.

We're looking for someone who enjoys solving problems, understanding complex workflows, configuring software, managing multiple moving pieces, and creating an onboarding experience that gives customers confidence they made the right investment.

**Who You Are**

You are an energetic, curious, and highly accountable implementation professional who enjoys being in front of customers as much as you enjoy getting into the details of how a platform should be configured.

You're comfortable taking an approved solution design, understanding the business intent behind it, and turning it into something real. You can work through complex business workflows, translate requirements into accurate platform configuration, work confidently with customer data, and explain how the resulting experience will work for the people using it.

You're also a strong project manager. You can manage multiple implementations at once, keep customers and internal teams accountable, identify dependencies before they become blockers, and create momentum without sacrificing quality.

You don't need to design every solution from scratch, but you do need to understand the solution you're implementing. You ask questions when something doesn't make sense, recognize when customer requirements have materially changed, challenge assumptions when appropriate, and know when to bring Solution Architecture back into the conversation before changes create unnecessary complexity, scope creep, or rework.

Most importantly, you bring energy to the customer experience. You're engaged, passionate about helping customers succeed, comfortable leading a room, and genuinely enjoy seeing customers move from complicated processes to confidently operating in Vividly.

**What You'll Do**

* Own the end-to-end implementation project for assigned customers, from post-Solution Alignment through configuration, training, UAT, go-live, and transition.
* Serve as the primary project manager and day-to-day customer lead throughout onboarding, owning timelines, milestones, dependencies, risks, decisions, customer actions, and overall project health.
* Translate approved Solution Architecture designs into accurate, scalable Vividly platform configuration.
* Configure customer workflows, master data, promotion structures, deduction-related settings, reporting requirements, user access, and other applicable platform components based on the approved solution.
* Understand the business purpose behind the configuration, not simply the individual fields or settings being configured.
* Prepare, transform, import, map, and validate customer datasets, including customer, product, pricing, revenue, and other applicable data.
* Validate configured workflows against the approved solution design and expected customer experience before progressing into training, UAT, and go-live.
* Lead customer implementation meetings with confidence, clear direction, and strong follow-through.
* Hold customers and internal stakeholders accountable to agreed actions, decisions, and timelines.
* Proactively identify risks, blockers, dependencies, and decisions that could impact scope, timeline, or customer readiness and drive them toward resolution.
* Coordinate cross-functional onboarding workstreams, including Integrations and Managed Services, while maintaining visibility into dependencies that impact the overall implementation.
* Deliver initial platform and workflow training to establish customer operational readiness and prepare users to begin successfully working in Vividly.
* Guide customers through UAT and confirm that configured workflows operate as intended before go-live.
* Assess customer readiness across configuration, data, training, integrations, services dependencies, and outstanding customer actions.
* Complete structured handoffs to Customer Success and Managed Services, ensuring important customer context, business outcomes, decisions, risks, and outstanding actions carry forward after implementation.
* Troubleshoot configuration and data issues, identify root causes, and coordinate with the appropriate internal teams when additional expertise is required.
* Identify recurring implementation challenges and contribute to improving our playbooks, templates, automation, processes, and overall customer onboarding experience.

**Solution Design & Change Management**

Implementation Managers execute against an approved solution design while maintaining enough business and product context to recognize when that design may need to be revisited.

In this role, you will:

* Use the approved Solution Architecture design as the source of truth for configuration and implementation execution.
* Understand the business requirements, assumptions, decisions, and intended customer experience behind the solution you're implementing.
* Recognize when newly discovered requirements or customer requests materially differ from the approved design.
* Challenge assumptions when a requested change could introduce unnecessary complexity, downstream risk, or significant rework.
* Distinguish between configuration decisions you can independently make and material solution changes that require Solution Architecture to re-engage.
* Escalate material design changes, new requirements, scope changes, or unresolved solution questions before changing the approved design.
* Document implementation decisions and ensure material changes are reflected in the appropriate solution and project documentation.
* Help customers move toward scalable future-state workflows rather than automatically recreating legacy processes simply because that's how they've historically operated.

**What You'll Bring**

* 3–5+ years of experience in SaaS implementation, implementation consulting, customer onboarding, or a similar customer-facing delivery role.
* Demonstrated experience hands-on configuring a SaaS platform based on documented business requirements or solution designs.
* Proven experience independently managing customer implementations from configuration through UAT, go-live, and handoff.
* Experience managing multiple concurrent customer projects with competing priorities, dependencies, stakeholders, and deadlines.
* Ability to understand complex business workflows and translate approved requirements into accurate system configuration.
* Strong judgment and the ability to recognize when a customer request represents a normal configuration decision versus a material change to an approved solution.
* Experience working with customer datasets using Excel or Google Sheets, including data validation, transformation, mapping, filtering, pivoting, and troubleshooting.
* Strong project management and organizational skills with an ability to create structure, maintain momentum, and drive accountability.
* Excellent customer-facing communication and facilitation skills, including the confidence to lead meetings, ask thoughtful questions, challenge assumptions, and explain complex workflows in practical terms.
* Strong problem-solving skills and comfort operating in ambiguity without waiting for someone else to provide every answer.
* Demonstrated ability to identify implementation risks early and drive decisions toward resolution.
* Ability to thrive in a fast-moving environment where priorities, processes, and products continue to evolve.
* A genuine passion for customer experience and helping customers successfully adopt new technology.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience implementing financial, ERP, accounting, planning, supply chain, retail, or other workflow-heavy SaaS products.
* Experience working with ERP systems, integrations, APIs, data migrations, or system-to-system workflows.
* Experience in consumer packaged goods (CPG), retail, trade promotion management (TPM), sales planning, finance, or accounting.
* Experience leading UAT, customer training, and change-management activities.
* Experience using AI or automation to improve implementation workflows, documentation, data preparation, configuration QA, or project efficiency.

**What Success Looks Like**

Within your first several months, you'll be able to independently take an approved customer solution and:

* Turn it into an accurate, operational Vividly configuration.
* Confidently lead the customer through their implementation plan and maintain momentum toward go-live.
* Manage multiple implementations simultaneously without sacrificing quality or customer experience.
* Understand enough of the customer's business process to explain why the platform is being configured a certain way—not simply how to configure it.
* Identify risks, dependencies, and potential design changes before they create downstream rework.
* Know when to make a configuration decision independently and when to bring Solution Architecture or another specialist back into the conversation.
* Prepare customers for successful go-live and provide Customer Success and Managed Services with a clean, structured handoff.
* Consistently deliver implementations that are on time, within scope, and positioned for long-term customer adoption and value.

**Why Choose Vividly?**

**A modern, remote-first workplace**

We are committed to succeeding as a fully remote team, empowering you with the flexibility to thrive, no commute required. Every Vividly team member receives a stipend upon hire to help create a comfortable, productive home office.

**Vividly days off & flexible PTO**

For most USA holidays that fall on a Monday or Friday, we turn it into a 4 day weekend! Vividly also offers Flexible Time Off (*and we really mean it*) to help prevent burn out and fuel creativity.

**Competitive Benefits**

* Healthcare, Dental and Vision - We cover 100% of your monthly premiums and 50% of all dependents
* 401(k) - With a 3% employer contribution
* Weekly $20 Sharebite Meal Stipend - For every meal you purchase, they donate a meal through Feeding America!
* Monthly $50 Wellness Reimbursement
* Monthly $200 Remote Work Stipend

**Commitment to our values - The Vividly Code**

* **Kind Ambition** -We push boundaries with empathy and integrity
* **Keep It Real** - We are transparent, honest, and authentic
* **Customer Love** - We act as trusted advisors to our customers
* **Own It** - We take responsibility and drive outcomes
* **Urgency Wins** - We move quickly and focus on impact
* **Pull Together** - We collaborate to win as a team

If an applicant is extended an offer of employment, such sensitive information will be requested at that time during the onboarding process. Vividly will never ask you to receive and ship packages or goods as part of the interview. Other practices to be on alert for:

jobs.title: Implementation Lead - ASO Employer Health Benefits
jobs.description:
XO Health believes healthcare is fixable. Become part of the community changing the face of the industry.

XO Health is the first health plan designed by and for self-insured employers that delivers a more unified health experience for everyone – from those who receive care, to those who deliver it, to those who pay for it.

We are growing a multi-disciplinary team of diverse and digitally empowered employees ready to rebuild trust in healthcare through comprehensive and unified transformation.

**ABOUT XO HEALTH:**

XO Health is a technology-driven health plan built for self-insured employers. We serve employers, members, and providers through a value-based care network, a risk contracting engine, and a real-time data and analytics platform. We are a small, fast-moving team where every person owns outcomes, not just tasks.

**ABOUT THE ROLE:**

The Implementation Lead owns the end-to-end onboarding of new employer groups and TPA partners, from signed agreement through effective date and a stable first 60 days. You are the single point of accountability for a clean, on-time go-live: the plan is built correctly, eligibility flows, ID cards and welcome kits land, the member app is configured, and the client knows exactly where things stand at every step.

This is a hands-on, build-the-playbook role. You will run implementations yourself while standardizing how XO does them, so that each one is faster and cleaner than the last. You will work across Commercial, Plan Operations, Claims, Network, IT, and Compliance, and you will be the person clients, brokers, and TPAs trust to get them live.

  

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Client and TPA Onboarding:**

* Lead the full implementation lifecycle for new employer groups and TPA partners, from kickoff through effective date and post-go-live stabilization.
* Build and maintain the implementation plan for each client: benefit design and plan documents, group structure, eligibility and enrollment setup, stop-loss coordination, vendor and partner integrations, member communications, and compliance requirements.
* Own the accurate setup of each group across XO's systems and partner platforms, including benefit configuration, eligibility file testing, ID card and welcome kit production, member app configuration, and any SSO or portal integrations.
* Translate client-specific requirements into clear instructions for internal teams and confirm they are executed correctly before go-live.

**Project Management:**

* Run the cross-functional implementation team and ensure critical milestones are completed. Surface risks early, resolve blockers, and escalate with a recommendation when needed.
* Coordinate with Claims, Plan Operations, Network, IT, Compliance, and Finance to ensure ownership is properly assigned and dates are adhered to .
* Maintain a regular reporting cadence with leadership and flag anything that puts a go-live at risk.

**Client Communication:**

* Serve as the primary contact for the client, broker, and TPA throughout implementation. Lead recurring status meetings and keep a clear record of open items and decisions.
* Prepare client-facing implementation documentation, checklists, and readiness sign-offs.
* Hand off cleanly to the ongoing account owner at the end of the stabilization period, with full documentation of the group's setup and any open items.

**Playbook and Continuous Improvement:**

* Own XO's implementation playbook: standard timelines, checklists, templates, and data requirements for employer and TPA onboarding.
* Identify manual steps and failure points in the process and work with Operations and Product to automate or remove them.
* Turn lessons from each implementation into playbook improvements that strengthen the process and enable scale ahead of growth.

**EXPERIENCE and EDUCATION:**

**Required:**

* 5+ years in implementation, client onboarding, or project management within self-funded health benefits, TPA operations, or a health plan.
* Working knowledge of self-funded medical and pharmacy plan design, and the compliance landscape that comes with it (ERISA, ACA, CAA, Mental Health Parity).
* Direct experience running complex, multi-party healthcare implementations on a fixed effective date.
* Fluency in the employer and TPA distribution channel, including how brokers, consultants, benefits administrators, and stop-loss carriers fit together.
* Comfort with eligibility files, enrollment data, and system configuration. You do not need to be technical, but you need to be precise and unafraid of the details.
* Clear, concise communicator who can confidently lead client discussions and provide leadership with direct, well-informed answers.
* Strong organizational skills and the judgment to prioritize when everything feels urgent.

**Preferred**:

* Experience implementing on behalf of, or alongside, a TPA.
* Experience at an early-stage or high-growth company where you built the process rather than inherited it.
* Familiarity with health plan technology platforms, member apps, or provider directory tools.
* PMP or similar project management credentials.

**KEY PERSONAL AND PROFESSIONAL ATTRIBUTES:**

***Accountability:*** you own the outcome and say so when something is off track.

***Critical Thinking:*** you solve problems from first principles and learn what the organization needs next.

***Change Champion:*** you are committed to building and comfortable when the plan changes.

***Relationships:***you build trust quickly with clients, partners, and colleagues.

XO Health is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex (including pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions), race, color, age, national origin, religion, disability, genetic information, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender reassignment, citizenship, immigration status, protected veteran status, or any other basis prohibited under applicable federal, state or local law. XO Health promotes a drug-free workplace.

jobs.title: Manager, Customer Implementations
jobs.description:
**About 3E:**
-------------

3E is a mission-driven company dedicated to creating a safer and more sustainable world. We offer award-winning regulatory intelligence and AI solutions to help organizations protect people and products. With over 35 years of experience and a global presence, we empower our customers with innovative compliance solutions.

You will get to work at a company that combines startup agility with the stability of an industry leader. Partner with enterprise customers and global experts to advance environmental safety and solve complex data science challenges.

***Join us and make an impact!***

**About the Role**

At 3E, customer implementation is where strategy becomes real for our customers. We’re looking for a **Manager, Customer Implementation** to lead and develop a U.S.-based team of approximately five to six professionals responsible for delivering successful SaaS implementations across our evolving portfolio of solutions. Reporting to the Senior Director of Customer Implementation, you’ll play a key role in strengthening team performance, driving delivery excellence, and creating a consistent, high-quality experience for our customers.

This is a highly visible leadership role for someone who brings together strong people leadership, project management, and customer judgment. You’ll coach and develop your team, set clear expectations, strengthen performance, and remove roadblocks while ensuring customers receive a consistent, high-quality implementation experience. You’ll also stay close to the work by supporting select strategic, multi-product implementations and collaborating across teams to navigate risks, changing priorities, and complex customer needs.

You’ll thrive in this role if you enjoy leading through change and bringing structure to complexity. You build trust with your team, address challenges directly, and help people take ownership of outcomes. You’re equally comfortable working across functions, engaging with customers, and helping your team move forward when every answer isn’t yet defined.

As 3E continues to evolve its approach to onboarding and implementation, you’ll also help your team embrace new products, processes, and technology, including practical uses of AI and automation that can make delivery more efficient. This is an opportunity to have meaningful ownership, develop a strong team, and directly influence the experience and outcomes of 3E customers.

**Location:** This position supports remote work within the Eastern time zone.

**What You’ll Do**

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of onboarding and implementation professionals responsible for enterprise SaaS deployments.
* Set clear expectations, monitor performance, provide actionable feedback, and help team members consistently meet customer and delivery standards.
* Oversee a portfolio of active implementations, using project and performance data to identify risks, remove roadblocks, and keep work moving toward successful outcomes.
* Help the team manage project plans, milestones, scope, dependencies, risks, and customer communication with consistency and discipline.
* Serve as a project leader or sponsor for a limited number of strategic, complex, or multi-product customer implementations, coordinating contributors across teams and geographies.
* Support customer escalations and help the team navigate challenging conversations, including scope, priorities, risks, and changing customer needs.
* Partner with Product, Customer Success, Commercial, Support, Technical Operations, and other teams to create a coordinated customer experience.
* Work with implementation leaders across regions to strengthen methodologies, processes, documentation, and delivery standards.
* Help the team adapt as 3E introduces new products, capabilities, and ways of working.
* Support ERP integrations and data migration initiatives, ensuring the appropriate technical resources are engaged while maintaining strong project coordination.
* Encourage the practical use and adoption of AI and automation to improve efficiency across project planning, communications, follow-up, organization, and other implementation workflows, while maintaining appropriate human oversight and sound judgment.

**What Makes You a Great Fit**

**Required Qualifications**

* 6+ years of experience in SaaS onboarding, implementation, or professional services, including experience leading complex, multi-product or multi-solution implementations.
* 2+ years of experience managing, coaching, and developing a delivery team.
* Strong project management fundamentals, including experience managing scope, milestones, dependencies, risks, escalations, and multiple concurrent priorities.
* Experience working directly with enterprise customers and communicating effectively with stakeholders at different levels of an organization.
* Ability to lead teams through changing priorities and evolving products, processes, and customer needs.
* Ability to balance people leadership with enough hands-on involvement in customer and project work to understand challenges and coach effectively.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with customers and internal stakeholders.
* Based in the US in one of the states where 3E is authorized to hire, and eligible to work without sponsorship.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience using AI tools to improve implementation, project management, customer communication, or operational workflows.
* Familiarity with AI-enabled productivity and automation tools such as Microsoft 365 Copilot, Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Automate, ChatGPT Enterprise, Claude, Gemini, or similar platforms.
* Experience identifying opportunities to automate or streamline manual processes using AI or workflow automation.
* Familiarity with responsible AI practices, including appropriate data handling, access controls, human review, and output validation.
* Experience with ERP integrations and complex data migration initiatives, such as SAP EHS.
* PMP or equivalent project management certification.
* Experience working across global or multicultural teams.
* Domain familiarity with EHS, Product Safety & Stewardship, Sustainable Supply Chain Management, or another regulated industry.

**Our US Benefits Include:**

* Health, dental, and vision insurance
* Life insurance and disability coverage
* Open PTO and parental leave
* 401(k) plan with company matching
* Employee assistance program
* Voluntary supplemental benefits (Accident, Hospital Indemnity, Critical Illness)

**3E is currently authorized to hire in the following U.S. states:**

Alabama, Arizona, California (excluding Los Angeles), Colorado (excluding Denver), Connecticut, Delaware, District of Columbia, Florida, Georgia, Illinois (excluding Chicago), Indiana, Kansas, Kentucky, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Nevada, New Jersey, New York (excluding New York City), North Carolina, Ohio, Oklahoma, Oregon, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Virginia, and Washington.

**Disclosures:**

3E is committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate based on any legally protected categories. For applicants who would like to request accommodation, please contact us here

Candidate Privacy Notice

**Agencies**: 3E is not accepting unsolicited assistance from search firms for this employment opportunity. All resumes submitted by search firms to any employee at 3E via email, the Internet, or in any form and/or method without a valid written search agreement in place for this position will be deemed the sole property of 3E. No fee will be paid if 3E hires the candidate because of the referral or through other means.

Visit our Website or follow us on LinkedIn

Compensation Range: $110K - $120K

Rooted in the principles of the Toyota Production System, we operate with precision, efficiency, and a relentless focus on continuous improvement to deliver a better experience for all. **About 3E:**
-------------

3E is a mission-driven company dedicated to creating a safer and more sustainable world. We offer award-winning regulatory intelligence and AI solutions to help organizations protect people and products. With over 35 years of experience and a global presence, we empower our customers with innovative compliance solutions.

You will get to work at a company that combines startup agility with the stability of an industry leader. Partner with enterprise customers and global experts to advance environmental safety and solve complex data science challenges.

***Join us and make an impact!***

**About the Role**

As an Implementation Specialist at 3E, you’ll turn a signed customer contract into a working, adopted solution. You’ll own hands-on implementation activities from kickoff through configuration, validation, foundational training, launch, and handoff—helping customers reach measurable first value from 3E’s products.

This role combines technical implementation, customer engagement, and project coordination. You’ll translate the agreed scope of work into a practical delivery plan, configure customer environments using real customer data, coordinate with technical and cross-functional partners, and keep milestones, risks, dependencies, and customer commitments visible throughout the engagement.

You’ll also support post-onboarding Value Realization Projects that help customers expand or improve their use of 3E through activities such as migrations, integrations, data remediation, inventory and catalog optimization, and workflow enablement.

You’ll work closely with the broader account team with clear ownership: the Implementation Specialist owns implementation delivery, the CSM owns ongoing adoption, and the AM owns the commercial account.

This role is well suited to someone who enjoys combining hands-on technical work with customer interaction, takes ownership of outcomes, and is comfortable working through changing priorities and ambiguity. Those characteristics also connect authentically with 3E's broader EVP around building, operating through ambiguity, and moving between planning and execution.

**Location:** This position supports remote work within the Eastern time zone.

**What You’ll Do**

* Lead assigned customer implementations from internal handoff and kickoff through configuration, validation, foundational training, launch, and formal handoff.
* Conduct implementation discovery and help confirm customer data readiness, environment requirements, security considerations, and integration prerequisites.
* Translate the scope of work into a documented implementation plan with milestones, deliverables, dependencies, assumptions, and customer responsibilities.
* Configure 3E customer environments, including inventory and structure, users and roles, integrations, and core workflows aligned with customer goals.
* Work directly with customer contacts and administrators to validate the solution and deliver foundational training.
* Coordinate with Product, Engineering, Data, Cloud, technical specialists, and external implementation partners as required for delivery.
* Track milestones and identify risks, dependencies, or potential scope changes early.
* Follow established change-control processes when customer requests extend beyond the agreed scope.
* Hold customers accountable for implementation commitments such as data readiness, resourcing, testing, and sign-offs.
* Execute post-onboarding Value Realization Projects such as migrations, data remediation, integrations, inventory optimization, and workflow enablement.
* Maintain accurate project records and documented handoffs while managing multiple concurrent implementations, keeping status, configuration, outcomes, risks, next steps, and training needs visible and prioritizing work based on customer impact, project risk, and key milestones.
* Build technical proficiency across 3E products and work credibly with technical teams to troubleshoot implementation issues and identify risks; coding is not required.
* Surface customer-identified bugs, product issues, and feature requests to the appropriate internal teams.

**What Makes You a Great Fit**

**Required**

* 2-3 years of experience in software implementation, customer onboarding, technical account or project management, or professional services, ideally within B2B SaaS, technology, or information services.
* Strong technical aptitude with demonstrated ability to configure software, troubleshoot setup issues, and learn new products.
* Experience managing multiple concurrent customer projects or implementations to deadlines and measurable outcomes.
* Ability to translate customer requirements and agreed scope into clear implementation activities, milestones, and deliverables.
* Strong written and verbal communication, prioritization, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Demonstrated experience working cross-functionally and building productive customer relationships.
* Proficiency with CRM tools such as Salesforce or HubSpot and Microsoft Office, with comfort working with data and systems of record.
* Ability to navigate ambiguity, competing priorities, and changing customer needs.
* Willingness to travel 10–20%.

**Preferred**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, information systems, environmental science, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Experience developing or improving onboarding processes and customer journeys.
* Familiarity with implementation, onboarding, or enablement tools such as Pendo, Gong, or Zendesk.
* Understanding of time-to-value, onboarding, adoption, or usage analytics.
* Exposure to environmental, regulatory, compliance, chemical management, SDS, EHS, or sustainability software.
* Multilingual capability and/or experience supporting customers across global markets.

This role must be based in one of the states where 3E is authorized to hire, and eligible to work without sponsorship.

**Our US Benefits Include:**

* Health, dental, and vision insurance
* Life insurance and disability coverage
* Open PTO and parental leave
* 401(k) plan with company matching
* Employee assistance program
* Voluntary supplemental benefits (Accident, Hospital Indemnity, Critical Illness)

**3E is currently authorized to hire in the following U.S. states:**

Alabama, Arizona, California (excluding Los Angeles), Colorado (excluding Denver), Connecticut, Delaware, District of Columbia, Florida, Georgia, Illinois (excluding Chicago), Indiana, Kansas, Kentucky, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Nevada, New Jersey, New York (excluding New York City), North Carolina, Ohio, Oklahoma, Oregon, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Virginia, and Washington.

**Disclosures:**

3E is committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate based on any legally protected categories. For applicants who would like to request accommodation, please contact us here

Candidate Privacy Notice

**Agencies**: 3E is not accepting unsolicited assistance from search firms for this employment opportunity. All resumes submitted by search firms to any employee at 3E via email, the Internet, or in any form and/or method without a valid written search agreement in place for this position will be deemed the sole property of 3E. No fee will be paid if 3E hires the candidate because of the referral or through other means.

Compensation Range: $60K - $70K

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.  
.

**Hiring and how we work**

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.  
.

**See yourself at Twilio**

Join the team as Twilio’s next Onboarding operations Specialist (L1).

**About the job**

Twilio is seeking an Operations Specialist to join the team that runs Twilio’s phone number operations globally. This role will work directly with customers to help them port their phone numbers into Twilio, procure Sender IDs, and have access to phone numbers they require for their applications. The Product Operations Specialist is the first tier on the Level 1 team. The Product Operations team is a key part of Twilio’s Super Network, whose mission is to provide the infrastructure that catalogs, orchestrates, and delivers the world's connectivity.

**Responsibilities**

In this role, you’ll:

* Provide support for common customer inquiries received by email to ensure customers have an excellent experience with Twilio.
* Assess the nature of product or service issues and resolve basic-to-intermediate level problems.
* Log customer interactions and tag/categorize issues accordingly.
* Learn new processes across a variety of subject areas and ensure our operations are running smoothly.
* Respond to and action incoming carrier partner notifications.
* Quickly and confidently triage complex issues to the Level 2 team.
* Effectively respond to advanced questions from customers (external and internal) in core area and intermediate questions across multiple areas.

As an Implementation Project Manager at 3E, you’ll lead larger, more complex customer implementations where successful delivery requires multiple products, technical contributors, workstreams, dependencies, and stakeholders to operate against one coordinated plan.

We are looking for a motivated Implementation Support Specialist to join our team and act as a friendly, forward-facing resource for participants, caregivers, and care staff for our special projects, namely: THRIVE@Home. In this project, older adults aging in place will be using our Rendever VR platform to connect with residents of local senior living communities, helping to reduce social isolation and improve wellbeing. This project is kicking off in October 2026 and is supported by an incredible team, and we’re excited to add this role to help participants and their support networks navigate any potential challenges that arise as our platform is used in more diverse settings.

The Implementation Support Specialist is responsible for helping customers, participants, and caregivers troubleshoot issues with their Rendever system, coordinating the setup and scheduling of training calls, maintaining records of technical support interactions, and collaborating with others to improve the company's overall technical support capabilities. During the first six months, the Specialist will focus on shadowing our experienced VR Support Specialist and assisting with participant training, gradually transitioning to primarily supporting study participants and their care teams. Execution and an operational mindset are essential for success in this role.

If you’re unafraid to lean into the unknown and find solutions to technical user challenges, and you find excitement in learning about cutting-edge technology, you’ve come to the right place! Of course, we’re certain you’ll be a part of collecting some pretty incredible moments of impact each day, and can’t wait to see the stories come in.

Roles & responsibilities

* Support the setup and deployment of study systems, including tracking system deliveries and scheduling training calls.
* Act as the first point of contact for all inbound technical support requests from study participants, caregivers, and members of their care team.
* Navigate troubleshooting requests to resolution, and communicate solutions and next steps to both internal and participants in a clear, patient, and accessible manner.
* Write and deliver Bug Logs that clearly details steps to reproduce the bug, the overall impact on system usage, and assign severity level for the issue
* Work collaboratively with the Research, Community Engagement, and Product teams to ensure that all technical issues are resolved in a timely manner, and relevant feedback is shared and integrated into the product roadmap
* Manage communications with communities, participants, and families, ensuring we maintain the proactive and responsive delivery time that our brand is known for

  
**Requirements**

**Customer service:**

As Rendever’s first point of contact for technical support, your customer service skills will be used to put customers at ease and help them solve their technical problems

**Planning:**

Organizing tasks and coordinating schedules for system deliveries, training calls, and support requests ensures you can manage daily responsibilities from beginning to end.

**Communication skills:**

Excellent listening and verbal communication skills are required to understand concerns from participants, caregivers, and care staff and clearly explain technical solutions to people with varying levels of comfort and experience with technology.

**Technical Support Skills:**

Strong technical support skills are required in this role. Familiarity and interest in working with and helping others use computers and other technology remotely is vital to success. Having a passion of understanding new technology will help the Implementation Support Specialist succeed when working with participants who are using experimental technology, which will many times not have straightforward a previously documented solutions. troubleshoot VR hardware and software issues.

**Time management:**

You’ll use time management skills to prioritize technical support requests, training calls, and system set up priorities quickly, allowing you to address all department expectations.

**Problem-solving skills:**

Leveraging problem-solving skills to diagnose technical issues, guide participants, caregivers, and care staff through solutions, and escalate concerns when necessary. Problem solving skills are vital in this role, as you discover new technical issues for the first time, and work with the proper team to get them resolved, and the systems up and running again as soon as possible.

jobs.title: Senior Implementation Specialist - Procurement Solutions
jobs.description:
At Bluesight, our mission is to create groundbreaking solutions that increase efficiency, safety and visibility for health systems, hospital pharmacy, and pharmaceutical manufacturers. We empower our customers to deliver the right medicine to the right patient at the right time, every time. We are a high growth healthcare information technology company with a start-up 'vibe' but over 3,000 customers using our proven solutions.

Bluesight is seeking an experienced Senior Implementation Specialist to lead client implementations of Procurement Solutions, which includes CostCheck, ShortageCheck and 340BCheck. CostCheck, our pharmacy purchasing and cost-savings optimization solution. CostCheck helps hospitals maximize pharmacy savings opportunities by monitoring spend against savings caps, GPO contract terms, and 340B program requirements. ShortageCheck predicts hospital and pharmacy drug shortages up to 90 days in advance, using market-wide signals — fulfillment delays, demand surges, usage trends — from over 3,250 healthcare organizations to give your team the lead time to plan ahead instead of scrambling once patient care is at risk. 340BCheck340BCheck unifies 340B data in one compliance command center, built on real HRSA audit requirements, so hospitals and grantees stay continuously audit-ready as their program grows. This is a senior role on the Implementation team, suited to someone who has already worked in hospital pharmacy purchasing or cost-savings optimization, and can bring that domain depth directly into how our customers configure and adopt Procurement solutions.

As a senior member of the team, this person will manage the most complex implementations — configuring systems to maximize potentials and fill gaps , and setting customers up on sound methodology from day one — act as a trusted advisor to customers' purchasing and pharmacy leadership, and help mentor other Implementation Specialists on purchasing-, supply- and cost-related workflows.

The ideal candidate is highly attentive to detail, comfortable talking with pharmacy buyers, purchasing directors, and finance stakeholders, and can operate in an environment that is often ambiguous and requires creativity to resolve issues.

### **Representative Duties & Responsibilities**

* Manage all aspects of Procurement Solution implementation projects, including project kick-off, software and pricing/contract configuration, go-live, and training, while maintaining project timelines.
* Configure and validate data, system outcomes, workflows, , and wholesaler/purchasing data feeds so customers' performance is tracked accurately from go-live.
* Act as the main point of contact for customers before they go live, owning all communications including weekly check-in meetings, ad hoc calls, and emails.
* Manage multiple implementation projects at once, across customers with different priorities, purchasing structures, and deadlines.
* Work as a consultative partner with customers' purchasing and pharmacy teams, advising on best practices for pharmacy cost-savings optimization, 340B compliance, and GPO/contract alignment.
* Train customer stakeholders on the CostCheck savings methodology and how to interpret savings-vs-cap performance so they're self-sufficient after go-live.
* Train customer stakeholders on the 340BCheck compliance and audit workflows within the system to provide them assistance in HRSA audits.
* Train customer stakeholders on ShortageCheck use and medication tracking.
* Act as a liaison between the customer, wholesalers/GPOs, and Bluesight's internal Clinical, Product, and Dev teams to facilitate technical and pricing configuration of the software.
* Maintain up-to-date project plans, tickets, and other project documentation so timelines stay on track and visible to leadership.
* Serve as a senior resource for the Implementation team on purchasing- and cost-related questions, helping onboard and support other Implementation Specialists.
* Travel to customer sites as needed to support rollout, meet with key stakeholders, and represent Bluesight professionally in front of customers.

### **Qualifications & Skills**

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in business administration, pharmacy, healthcare management, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
* 5+ years of professional experience, with a background aligned to hospital pharmacy purchasing, buying, procurement, or pharmacy cost-savings optimization (e.g., experience as a buyer or in a similar purchasing-facing role).
* 2+ years of project management and/or client-facing experience, ideally implementation-related.
* Strong familiarity with pharmacy cost savings programs, 340B program requirements, and group purchasing organizations (GPOs) preferred.
* Experience in the healthcare industry, ideally hospital pharmacy or health-system purchasing.
* Strong financial and data analysis skills, with the ability to assess savings performance and identify optimization opportunities during implementation.
* Ability to adapt to change, think quickly, and work independently.
* Team-player attitude and a willingness to get things done, including mentoring less-senior teammates.
* High attention to detail.
* Ability to build trusting, communicative, and results-oriented relationships with customers, including purchasing and finance stakeholders.
* Excellent verbal and written communication and interpersonal skills.
* ***Willingness and ability to travel within the US as needed.***

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Certified Pharmacy Technician (CPhT) credentials a strong plus.
* ACE certification a strong plus.
* Excel and SQL skills a plus.
* Previous experience with EMRs/ADCs (e.g., EPIC and Cerner) or purchasing/wholesaler platforms a plus.

The standard base pay range for this role is $75,000 - $85,000 when annualized. In addition to base salary this position is also eligible for an amazing benefits package. Actual amount of salary will vary depending on position offered, experience, performance, and location.
